instruction: I'm working on my academic homepage based on the academicpages template in ~/Code/Website. I need to personalize the sidebar information in the _config.yaml file. Please find the author section and update the bio field to "Machine Learning Researcher" and the name field (the sidebar name, not the main name) to "Dr. Smith".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to update biographical information in the YAML configuration. The agent must locate the 'author.bio' and 'author.name' fields (the sidebar name at line 25, not the main name at line 13) in _config.yml and update them to 'Machine Learning Researcher' and 'Dr. Smith' respectively. The evaluator uses the existing check_json metric with is_yaml=true to verify these fields. The task complexity matches the original - finding and editing specific nested YAML fields.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the YAML config file from VM after saving via postconfig
Metric check_json with is_yaml=true properly parses YAML and navigates to nested keys
Both instruction requirements are verified: author.bio and author.name fields with exact matching
Expected values match instruction requirements exactly: 'Machine Learning Researcher' and 'Dr. Smith'
Comprehensive error handling for file fetch failures, YAML parse errors, and missing keys
Static warning about type mismatch is false positive - get_vm_file returns Optional[str] in single-file mode which check_json handles correctly

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
